intro: We do not publish package tiers, because no two projects in this valley are the same — an 1890s row home in Scranton and a 1990s build in Dallas need different work at different prices. What we will do is tell you the real ranges up front so you are not guessing. Most residential landscaping projects in NEPA run $3,000 to $25,000+. Paver patios generally run $20 to $45 per square foot installed. Small renovations take 2–4 weeks, additions 6–12 weeks, and new builds 6–9 months. Every project gets a free on-site visit and an itemized written estimate — materials, labor and timeline — before anyone commits to anything.
notes: Retaining walls over 4 feet typically require engineering and permits in Pennsylvania. We handle both, and the cost is itemized in your estimate rather than added later.
